SELECT sergey_rodionov.services.id AS sergey_rodionov_services_id, sergey_rodionov.services.name AS sergey_rodionov_services_name, sergey_rodionov.services.duration_minutes AS sergey_rodionov_services_duration_minutes 
FROM sergey_rodionov.services 
WHERE sergey_rodionov.services.id = %(pk_1)s::BIGINT

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT sergey_rodionov.slots.id AS id, sergey_rodionov.slots.specialist_id AS specialist_id, sergey_rodionov.slots.service_id AS service_id, sergey_rodionov.slots.starts_at AS starts_at, sergey_rodionov.slots.ends_at AS ends_at, sergey_rodionov.specialists.id AS id_1, sergey_rodionov.specialists.full_name AS full_name, sergey_rodionov.specialists.specialization AS specialization, sergey_rodionov.services.id AS id_2, sergey_rodionov.services.name AS name, sergey_rodionov.services.duration_minutes AS duration_minutes 
FROM sergey_rodionov.slots JOIN sergey_rodionov.specialists ON sergey_rodionov.slots.specialist_id = sergey_rodionov.specialists.id JOIN sergey_rodionov.services ON sergey_rodionov.slots.service_id = sergey_rodionov.services.id 
WHERE sergey_rodionov.slots.service_id = %(service_id_1)s::BIGINT AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT sergey_rodionov.appointments.id 
FROM sergey_rodionov.appointments JOIN sergey_rodionov.slots AS slots_1 ON sergey_rodionov.appointments.slot_id = slots_1.id 
WHERE sergey_rodionov.appointments.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND slots_1.specialist_id = sergey_rodionov.slots.specialist_id AND slots_1.starts_at < sergey_rodionov.slots.ends_at AND slots_1.ends_at > sergey_rodionov.slots.starts_at)) AND EXTRACT(epoch FROM sergey_rodionov.slots.ends_at - sergey_rodionov.slots.starts_at) = sergey_rodionov.services.duration_minutes * %(duration_minutes_1)s::INTEGER AND sergey_rodionov.slots.starts_at >= %(starts_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND sergey_rodionov.slots.starts_at < %(starts_at_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_1
